value.rationale: All real two-frequency eigenspace restrictions of a classical circle Markov semigroup form a natural spectral approximation family. An exact all-parameter classification shows finite-time selection of the lower eigenspace except at 3-to-1 resonance, where a higher-frequency component remains necessary for every positive radius; gives sharp gap-controlled contractivity, unique phase-locked extremizers and explicit algebraic threshold. This is structural stability information absent from coarse unrestricted hypercontractive estimates.
